description.text: Teaching Objective Mastering basic theory and systematic specialties in mining engineering, and two foreign languages, developing scientific research by himself, making creative achievements in science or special technology. Educational Requirements 1. Well understand the deep theories and ongoing policy issues concerning mining engineering and keep updated along with their advancement; 2. Built an independent thinking ability on mining engineering theories and their applications; 3. Create strong potentials to communicate with governments, firms, NGOs and team members; 4. Write research papers, be capable in conducting seminars and working activities; 5. Have the technique to conduct international business management and develop career potentials. Major Course Advanced Mining Engineering Modern Explosion Physics New Theory of Rock Mechanics Mineral Economics and Evaluation New Development of Rock Blasting Theory and Technology Soft Rock Engineering Mechanics Intelligence Rock Mechanics Numerical Simulation of Explosion Mechanics Digital Mine Duration 3 academic years

duration.text: The Mining Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport with photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. The TOEFL IBT score of 70 points at least, or IELTS score at least 5.5, or the relevant certificates of English as the working and learning language for university study. 2. Completed application form. 3. Notarized Copies of Highest diploma and transcripts. 4. Two recommendation letters. 5. Research Plan 6. Physical Examination Report. 7. Digital photo (Passport size) and photocopy of passport
